projects.title: Enterio: Movie & Show Guide
projects.description: Enterio is an app that provides essential information about the content, including genres, alternative titles, synopsis, and production companies. Additionally, users can read viewer reviews from TMDB and watch trailers or teasers from YouTube.

projects.title: MediaMeld: Wallpaper App
projects.description: Transform your device with a handpicked collection of high-resolution wallpapers with multiple categories. Enjoy a curated library of premium artwork designed for your home and lock screens, complete with offline downloads, and quick one-tap setup to personalize your display instantly.

projects.title: Sangeet
projects.description: Sangeet is a simple and elegant music player app developed using Flutter and Dart. It's designed to make it easy for users to enjoy their favorite offline music stored on their devices. This app offers a clean user interface, music categorization by album and artist, and a convenient search feature.

projects.title: Futsal Dai: Futsal Management App
projects.description: A mobile application designed for booking venues, managing schedules, and coordinating local group matches with integrated backend database structures.
